Department Alert
DRIVERS LICENSE, STATE ID CARDS, AND MOTOR VEHICLES OWNERSHIP TRANSFERS (including vehicle titles, all trailers and all new Iowa resident transfers) can be done by appointment.
Walk-ins welcome prior to 4:00 pm! We have a kiosk that you can sign in as a walk-in.
However, if you book online or call us for an appointment, we can ask screening questions to make sure you bring all necessary documents with you. Your time is valuable, and we truly want to serve our customers in one visit with no waiting. Appointments also allow us to contact you should our systems go down, office closures, inclement weather, etc., and we are unable to serve you.
Registrations, license plate switches/turn-ins, and PROPERTY TAX PAYMENTS are typically quick and easy and DO NOT need an appointment.
